\caption{\textbf{Full retention decomposition, with the positive control interval.} $\mathrm{Ret}(\text{none})$, $\mathrm{Ret}(\text{rand})$ and $\mathrm{Ret}(\text{pred})$ are agreement with the model's own full-video answer under the blind, random and predicted window; $\mathrm{SG} = \mathrm{Ret}(\text{pred}) - \mathrm{Ret}(\text{rand})$ and $\mathrm{SG}_{\text{gt}} = \mathrm{Ret}(\text{gt}) - \mathrm{Ret}(\text{rand-gt})$.
